Who Am I?

I'm a passionate Android Developer and Software Engineering undergraduate at Quaid-e-Awam University, Nawabshah. I specialize in building high-quality Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM architecture, and Firebase.

With hands-on experience across freelancing on Fiverr, internships, and personal projects, I've shipped 9+ production-grade apps spanning e-commerce, food delivery, fintech, fitness, transportation, and social domains.

I'm a certified META Android Developer, and I believe in writing clean, maintainable code that solves real problems for real users.
